minBlobLength.description: Shortest base64 or hex run reported as an encoded blob (default 64, range 8-64; a longer minimum would let bigger blobs through). Lower catches shorter blobs and charges more legitimate ids and hashes.

entropyThresholdBits.description: Character entropy in bits per character above which a message of 32 or more characters is flagged (default 5.4, range above 0 to 5.4).

incompressibleRatio.description: DEFLATE compressed-to-raw size ratio above which a message of 64 or more characters is flagged as incompressible (default 0.92, range above 0 to 0.92).
